findings.text: blocking: repair_completion reads ledger.load's union at reckon/ledger.py:3644 and writes it back at line 3709, so on any project holding per-run files it now raises the fold refusal instead of persisting; reproduced in a scratch tree as ledger.repair_completion(project, root, write_changes=True, streams_root=...) against a 10-row aggregate with 50 run files, which raised LedgerError "this write would fold 50 run row(s) already held as per-run files into the aggregate". The CLI path reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2563 reaches it, and its tests seed an unsplit aggregate (tests/test_ledger.py:355 asserts no run file exists), so the change breaks a production writer the node was required to repoint and no test covers it.

follow-on: _write_run_row is added here and identically at scripts/backfill_run_durations.py:255, replicating the run-file amend idiom already written at reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:547 and effectively ledger's own _keep_run_files_identical at reckon/ledger.py:1602, so one mechanism now has four copies with no single owner.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 2e9a07c237; nine commits change reckon/ledger.py's guard and loader, the five writers plus register_member, the fold test, test_hold_check and three fixture files, and one evidence fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_the_ledger_writer_refuses_a_fold.py over a 10-row aggregate and 50 per-run files, a one-run append accepted and a hold check leaving the row count unchanged; logs/attempt2-gate-final.log records 14 passed EXIT=0 and logs/attempt2-negative-control-final.log records 9 failed EXIT=1, so the named cases are measured and logged.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is a fold refusal in ledger.write with record_hold_checks reading the aggregate's own rows; both land at reckon/ledger.py:1835 and reckon/ledger.py:3798, but one production caller that reaches the same refusal is left unrepaired at reckon/ledger.py:3709, so the goal's own requirement that every writer be repointed is not fully met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, the head gate 14 passed EXIT=0, the pre-guard base arm 9 failed EXIT=1, the eleven-id arm 11 passed, the three files 60 passed and the other-site arm 68 passed, and names each log, though it records baseline_suite and after_suite as null.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node's declared scope (reckon/ledger.py, the five writers, register_member, three fixture files, test_hold_check_leaves_the_tree_clean.py, the fold test and one evidence fragment, extended by the two resume advices) covers every path in git diff 2e9a07c237..d26206af9; no path in the diff falls outside it.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_ledger_writer_refuses_a_fold.py:113 asserts against the fixture's own PER_RUN_FILES, not a value passed to write, and the base arm shows the guard absent, but no case covers the unrepaired caller at reckon/ledger.py:3709.
justifications.evidence: logs/attempt2-gate-final.log ends 14 passed EXIT=0 and logs/attempt2-negative-control-final.log ends 9 failed EXIT=1 over tests/test_the_ledger_writer_refuses_a_fold.py, so the done_when's cases are logged, but the head arm log is at 80a282c4b one revision before the reviewed head and the manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as null.
justifications.fit: _folded_run_ids at reckon/ledger.py:892 and load_aggregate at reckon/ledger.py:959 follow the module's helper idiom and carry no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1835 refuses an incoming row whose per-run file exists, naming how many would fold, and reckon/ledger.py:3798 reads the aggregate's own rows, which is the goal, but reckon/ledger.py:3709 still folds the union.
justifications.reuse: load_aggregate wraps the existing _load_aggregate owner, but _write_run_row is added at scripts/derive_run_figures.py:101 and scripts/backfill_run_durations.py:255 as two copies of one run-file amend idiom already written at reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:547 beside ledger's own _keep_run_files_identical at reckon/ledger.py:1602.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 2e9a07c237..d26206af9 lies inside the declared scope plus the two documented resume extensions.
